rule_outs: Dwelling 5 m from the best section
summary: Steep cul-de-sac head with a house 5 m from the kerb.

drivers.seclusion: Homes encircle the turning head, 5 to 17 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with no verge; a parked van would block the head.
drivers.traffic: Very quiet dead end serving a few homes.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Fri 7-6, residents excepted; no cars parked on the kerb in the imagery.

sun_shade: Tree canopy shades much of the lane, mainly from the west.
